Free van wrap design

From concept to fitted van.

The Van Designer is a free way to try van graphics and wrap ideas before you speak to us. It lays out your business name, services and contact details on a van of the right size, in graphics or a full printed wrap, so you can compare looks in minutes.

When you are happy with a concept, request a quote from the designer. Our Norwich team turns it into a production-ready layout for your exact vehicle, checks the panels, handles and seams, and sends a proof before anything is printed. Fitting is arranged at our workshop on Vulcan Road North.

Prefer to talk it through? Explore van signwriting, vehicle wraps and fleet graphics, or call 01603 407786.

Before you book

Good to know.

Is the Van Designer free?

Yes. Create a free account with your name and email to use it. There is no obligation to order, and your designs are saved to your account so you can come back on any device.

Why do I need to sign up?

Your account saves your designs and lets the Norwich team follow up with a quote if you ask for one. There is no password: we email you a login link for other devices. We only use your details for that unless you tick the marketing box.

How do I get back to my designs?

On the same device you stay signed in. On another phone or computer, choose Email me a login link on the designer page and use the link we send. It works once and lasts 48 hours.

Will my van look exactly like the design?

The designer gives you an instant concept. Before anything is printed, our team checks your vehicle, adjusts the layout around handles, seams and windows, and sends a proof for approval.

Can I use my own logo?

Yes. Upload a PNG, JPG or SVG. The designer picks your brand colours from the logo, and you can change them. For production we will ask for a vector logo if you have one.

What is the difference between graphics and a full wrap?

Graphics are vinyl lettering and logos on your existing paintwork. A full wrap covers most of the exterior panels in printed vinyl. Our van signwriting and vehicle wraps pages explain both in more detail.

Which vans can I design?

Small, medium and large vans from Ford, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Vauxhall, Renault, Citroën, Peugeot, Toyota, Nissan and Fiat, in short or long wheelbase. Tell us if yours is not listed and we will design it for you.

What are the 360° and lifestyle views?

The 360° view lets you spin your van to check the sides and rear. The lifestyle view shows your design in scenes such as a motorway, city street or building site. Both are illustrations to help you picture the result.

What happens after I request a quote?

Your design and vehicle details go to the Norwich team, who will confirm the price, film and fitting date. You will see a proof before anything is produced.
